image_description: A side-profile view of a customized, two-seater golf cart parked on a paved surface. The cart features a metallic orange/gold body with black accents, a beige fabric canopy roof supported by white pillars, and grey upholstered seats. It has small wheels with dark rims and orange tire sidewalls. A potted palm plant is visible in the background to the right.
